label: pairwise_artist_signature_camera_composition_011
resolved_prompt: Compose one continuous single-view vertical image built around exactly one clearly adult woman as the only figure. Every visible face, body, and hand belongs to this same woman. Place a clearly visible strip of background above her entire hairstyle, and keep her complete crown, facial profile, and visible profile eye clearly readable. The second camera direction is the measured axis. Obey its literal crop, side view, field of view, asymmetric placement, and negative-space counterweight. Create a clean hand-drawn two-dimensional editorial illustration. The exact name-free signature controls the visible medium, face, eyes, silhouette, palette, light, composition, and ornament. Make these eight cues bold and unmistakable: line language—fine lace-like contours with sharp taper; face design—a short compact oval face; eye design—round eyes with visible radial irises; body design—a balanced narrow silhouette visible at mid-thigh scale; palette language—dark nocturnal blue with bright neon accents; light modeling—hard-edged two-value cel light and shadow; framing language—many large overlapping paper panels clearly visible across the full background behind the figure, expressed in the background while the measured camera controls subject placement; ornament language—repeated textile bands and woven motifs. Draw face and eye details crisply within the mid-thigh figure. Put the ornament on both the garment and outer border. Keep the visible figure in front of every decorative framing element. Combine it coherently with this second visual direction: Photograph an adult subject using vertical full-scene framing with uninterrupted headroom and a stable foreground anchor from a gently elevated camera position that reveals shoulder and floor relationships. The view uses gentle portrait compression with smooth feature spacing and a softly enlarged background and rule-of-thirds placement with open space extending in the direction of the gaze. Resolve both directions on the same adult subject. Give every named visual cue an obvious, concrete location on the face, clothing, silhouette, lighting, or environment. Preserve the selected medium and keep the face, eyes, visible hands, joints, garment construction, and spatial relationships coherent. Finish the single scene cleanly with text-free, logo-free, watermark-free imagery. Final camera lock—use an eye-level mid-thigh inspection frame with the lower edge visibly intersecting both thighs and the complete crown, both eyes, shoulders, and visible hand gestures inside while the knees, calves, shoes, and feet continue beyond the canvas.
